tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos grwa lho byang thun mong gi rung khang pa rnams nas bya dgos rnam gzhag bzhugs so// byang gtso 'gyur gyi chos sde thun mong gi rung khang pa rnams nas nges dgos/ rang gzhan gyi rgyud la sgrib sbyong tshogs gsog gi yul dam pa dge 'dun gyi sde yin zhing / de'i nang nas kyang chos grwa lho byang 'di la sa skya gong ma rim can nas mchod yul bla na med pa'i thugs rtsis zhig 'dug don ltar/ rgyun gyi zhabs tog bsnyen bkur gyi rim pa phun sum tshogs pa zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam drag re'i rung khang gsar bkod byas pa yin pas/ khyed rung khang pa tshang mas las ka byed dgos kyi rim par gtso bo chos 'jig rten gyi bya ba gang byed kyang / lhag bsam rnam dag gis dkon mchog thugs zhe mi khrel zhing / rang la tshe 'dir mgo yod kyis 'jur thag tsha drag can dang / gzhan gyi mi kha mi 'byung ba dang / phyi ma ngan song sogs kyi sdug bsngal myong mi dgos pa'i do dam rang sems dpang por bzhag pa'i rang gis rang gcur thub pa zhig rang gal che bas/ de ltar go cha byas ngos/ bde chen gling pa rnams kyi sgrig lam kun spyod phyag bzhes kyi gtso bor ban gtsang pa rnams kyi dmigs bsal la tshes gcig bsangs bskang gso/ tshes gsum bskang gso/ tshes bzhi'i rnam sras/ zla re'i bla mchod dang / tshes mchod brgyad bcu bzhi nyer gsum/ nyer drug nas gnam gang bar gyi dus gtor/ nyer lnga'i gur drag sman bla rnams zla re bzhin chag med dang / rgya 'gros pa'i bskang gso smon lam/ spyan snga ba ngag dbang chos grags dang ka spe ba'i bla mchod/ zung 'dzugs dam tshig bskang gso mdos bskang / gtor spod nged rang yod tshe skyed lhas bsam gling la bar thab nas kyi rigs/ ril sgrub dang / mdos chen gyi bskang gso brgya tshar/ mgon po mnga' gsol/ rab gnas chen mo gang dgos mdos chen gtso bo'i dbyangs sbyang / lha mo gsol mchod/ nged rang yod tshe bar ja gang 'gro/ mdos sde/

drug pa tshes bzhi rnams dang 'tshogs 'du'i rigs tshang ma dang / dge 'dun byings dang mnyam 'tshogs la/ zla re'i rgyu/ rnal 'byor ma/ sgrub mchod gtor bzlog mgon khang mtshan thogs sogs bskang ba'i rigs/ bsnyen song rnams kyi dmigs bsal seng sgra chab klu khrus gtor chen bkra shis lha khang gi rnam rgyal sogs byang du dgos pa'i 'tshogs 'du rus ma rnams dang / tshe chog kun rig rnam rgyal/ bstan pa gso chog sil gtor/ chos sgrog mang grwa/ dbyar dgun gyi gzhis len/ gsung chos sa tshwa/ lag len ba'i grol ja/ rig bya sogs lho'i tshogs 'du dus ma rnams dang / gzhan yang chos grwa lho byang gi 'tshogs 'du 'phar ma'i rigs ji snyed byung ba/ de thams cad la 'jam gsol ja skyo ma sogs bsnyen bkur gyi rigs gang dgos thams cad dang / sgo rum bskang rgyun bzhi/ 'jam 'don gzungs 'don rnams la grwa rer nyin ltar skyogs bzhi re/ sgrol ma 'bum ther gyi nyung ja cho 'phrul phra 'jam dang / skyed lhas bsam gling gtor spod phebs 'phral gyi bzhes thug rnams mchod spro zhing mdog legs pa/ dge 'dun rnams tshim zhing / yon bdag rnams bsam pa rdzogs pa thun mong du dang ba 'gro ba kho na ma gtogs/ las sla dang rgyus ma thon pa'i rtags/ kha dog dang ro bzang ngan sna tshogs ska sla ma 'tsham pa sogs dngos po bzang la lag len ngan pa'i rtags byung na/ dngos po de ngo ma'am de dod pher ba zhig gi chad pa mgo yod kyis mtshon tshang mar 'gel rgyu yin pas de bzhin du ma song ba zhig dang / gzhan yang ma byin len sogs/ mig nye ngan pa nyag brkyang byung tshe/ phyi lam khegs pa'i do dam byed rgyu yin pa'ang khyed tshang mas nges dgos/ phur sgrub chen mo dang / mdos chen bka' 'gyur sogs grwa rigs gang yin la 'gro zhing / 'bras sil gyi rigs bar thab dang shod thab nas thon pa byed rgyu dang / chu tshang ma ja dpon pa'i lag bde ba rnams kyis len pa dang /

me shing shing dpon gyis do dam byas pa'i bzang lci gang dgos gtong rgyu dang / dus 'phar dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur zhu rgyu'i yo byad rnams tshang ma'i do dam dang / rung khang 'di la mkho ba'i bya ba thams cad kyi mgo 'chun las thogs pas byas ngos/ de la ja dpon lag bde ba rnams kyis phyogs gcig byas thog nas/ gtsang sbra sogs dge 'dun gyi zhabs tog la rang don thag pa khur blangs kho na gal che/ rung khang 'dir las byed pa rnams dang / dge 'dun gyi rigs/ drung 'khor ser skya drag pa rnams ma gtogs gzhan mi gtong bar sbyin bdag gi ngo 'dzin tshang ma las thogs pa rang gi shag sogs stabs gang bder byed pa dang / 'di nas dge 'dun gyi gsol zas kho na dang de'i rjes 'brel du dgos pa dus mdos skabs drug cu mthil pa dang khang gnyer/ gtor bzlog rnams kyi gtor khur ba sogs/ gzhis len skabs kyi dngul tib pa sogs/ sbud 'bud pa 'phar ja'i sbyin bdag rnams dang / tshes mchod gzhung sger gyi rigs la gzhung ja 'dren mi skya bo gang 'os las thogs pas 'tshol ba dang / sger pa rnams rang rang gis btsal ngos kyi rgyab du ja dpon nam/ lag bde ba rgan pa gang rung phyin pa'i 'dren 'os tshang mar chad lhag med pa'i do dam yang dag byed dgos tsam ma gtogs/ gzhan skya bo'i rigs la mi ster zhing / dge 'dun gyi gsol ba'i lhag ma ja ro/ ja mar gyi phyi thum ko ba sogs ro ma rnams der yod rnams kyis longs spyad kyang rung mod/ de dag la bsnyad btags ha cang gi rgya che mu med byas pa shar tshe do dam gong mtshungs yong zhing / 'dir las babs dang bstun chang sogs 'grim 'grul dgos pa byung tshe/ rung khang ma yin pa'i gzhan zhig tu 'thung rgyu la bag med du ma song ba dang / tshes gsum dang brgyad sogs dkar me dus mar bzhu dgos rnams lag bde ba rnams nas snga phyi skabs gang babs su 'phro brlag med par bzhus nas tho sher ba phyag gnyer ngo tshab dang /

bcu skyogs pa ja dpon dang / lnga skyogs pa lag bde ba rgan pas rgyag cing / dus chen skabs zhal zas bzo mi/ bsnyen song gang dgos la/ bde gling chos khrims pas bkod khyab byed rgyu yin pas/ de dag la'ang gtsang sbra lag len dngos gtsang rang gzhan gyi 'di phyi'i don 'grub pa zhig thams cad nas go 'tshal/ gong gsal gyi ja mar tshwa 'bras tshang ma thog mar gtan 'bebs yang dag bgyis pa'i thog dngos chas ma nyung ma mang pa dkrigs sbyar yong ba dang / dge 'dun zhal grangs mang nyung 'di yod las thogs pa phyag gnyer du lan gsal sprad pa'i thob gzhi 'degs shor ba byed// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 kun dga' blo gros/ chos grwa lho byang thun mong gi rung khang pa rnams nas bya dgos rnam gzhag PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
